name: Abdominal Stretch
Text: When successfully played, you may discard 3 cards, search through your Arsenal and put 1 card into your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Ankle Lock
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Arm Bar
Text: When successfully played, discard 1 card of your choice from your hand.

name: Arm Bar Takedown
Text: As an action, you may discard this card to draw 1 card. Doing this will not cause any damage to opponent.

name: Arm Drag
Text: When successfully played, discard 1 card of your choice from your hand.

name: Atomic Drop
Text: When successfully played, if your next card played this turn is a maneuver it is +2D.

name: Austin Elbow Smash
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D or greater maneuver. Cannot be reversed.

name: Ayatollah of Rock 'n' Roll-a
Text: Look at your opponent's hand. Your maneuvers cannot be reversed from his Arsenal for the rest of the turn.

name: Back Body Drop
Text: The card titled Irish Whip must be played before playing this card. When successfully played, you may either draw 2 cards, or force opponent to discard 2 cards.

name: Bear Hug
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Belly to Back Suplex
Text: May only reverse the maneuver titled Belly to Back Suplex.

name: Belly to Belly Suplex
Text: May only reverse the maneuver titled Belly to Belly Suplex.

name: Boston Crab
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Break the Hold
Text: Reverse any Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Bulldog
Text: When successfully played, discard 1 card of your choice from your hand. Look at opponent's hand, then choose and discard 1 card from his hand.

name: Camel Clutch
Text: When successfully played, look through your Arsenal for the card titled Maintain Hold and place that card in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Cheap Shot From the Corner
Text: To play this card you must be an 'inactive' player of your team. After your 'active'partner has successfully played a maneuver of 5D or greater, you can play this card as the very next card against his opponent. Opponent may attempt to reverse the maneuver as usual.

name: Chicken Wing
Text: When successfully played, shuffle 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Choke Hold
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Chop
Text: As an action, you may discard this card to draw 1 card. Doing this will not cause any damage to opponent.

name: Chris Jericho
Text: Once during each of your turns you may discard 1 card and then your opponent discards 1 card.

name: Chyna Interferes
Text: Reverses any maneuver and ends your opponent's turn. If played from your hand, draw 2 cards.

name: Clean Break
Text: When played from your hand, reverse the cards titled Jockeying for Position, Clutch onto Opponent, Half Hour Suplex, Gut Wrench, or Indian Deathlock and end your opponent's turn. Draw 1 card and your opponent discards 4 cards.

name: Clothesline
Text: When successfully played, if your next card played this turn is a maneuver it is +2D.

name: Cobra Clutch
Text: When successfully played, look through your Arsenal for the card titled Maintain Hold and place that card in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Collar and Elbow Lockup
Text: As an action, you may discard this card to draw 1 card. Doing this will not cause any damage to opponent.

name: Combination Attack
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D+ maneuver. When played, an inactive partner may discard 1 6D+ maneuver and this card is +#D, where # is the Damage of the discarded maneuver.

name: Comeback!
Text: Discard 3 cards of your choice from your hand. All players compare their current Fortitude Rating. The player(s) with a higher Fortitude Rating must remove maneuver and/or reversal cards from their Ring area, putting them into his Ringside pile, until that player's Fortitude Rating is less than or equal to the others.

name: Cross Body Block
Text: The card titled Irish Whip must be played before playing this card. May only reverse a maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip.

name: DDT
Text: When successfully played, overturn 1 card and your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Deluding Yourself
Text: Draw 4 cards. At end of turn, discard your hand.

name: Discus Punch
Text: Reversals to this maneuver are +2D

name: Disqualification!
Text: Reverse any HEEL maneuver or reversal card if that opponent has 5 or more HEEL cards in his Ring area. Opponent is Disqualified and you win the game. This effect happens even if the card titled Disqualification is placed into your Ringside pile while applying damage from a HEEL maneuver or reversal card.

name: Distract the Ref
Text: Draw 1 card. Look at opponent's hand. If he has any cards titled Disqualification! he must discard them.

name: Diversion
Text: If your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it cannot be reversed.

name: Don't Think Too Hard
Text: Look at the top 5 cards of an opponent's Arsenal. You may either arrange them in any order or make him shuffle his Arsenal.

name: Don't You Never ... EVER!
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Your opponent discards 2 cards and on your next turn your maneuvers are +2D.

name: Double Arm DDT
Text: May only reverse the maneuver titled Back Body Drop.

name: Double Digits
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Your opponent discards 2 cards and overturns 2 cards.

name: Double Leg Takedown
Text: When successfully played, you may draw 1 card.

name: Double Team
Text: To play this card, you must be the 'active'legal player of your team. If your previously played card was a successfully played maneuver, a tag team partner may now play a single maneuver against your 'active'opponent at a bonus +5D. Opponent may attempt to reverse the maneuver as usual.

name: Drop Kick
Text: May only reverse the maneuver titled Drop Kick.

name: Ego Boost
Text: Your next card played this turn is -5F. When your opponent causes you to discard this card, draw up to 2 cards.

name: Elbow to the Face
Text: Reverse any maneuver of 7D or less and end your opponent's turn.

name: Ensugiri
Text: May only reverse the maneuver titled Kick.

name: Escape Move
Text: Reverse any Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Facebuster
Text: When played from your hand, reverse any maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip and end your opponent's turn. Draw up to 2 cards.

name: Figure Four Leg Lock
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Fireman's Carry
Text: When successfully played, you may look at your opponent's hand.

name: Fisherman's Suplex
Text: When successfully played, overturn 1 card and you may draw 1 card.

name: Flash in the Pan
Text: Draw 1 card. Look at opponent's hand, and then make him discard all HEEL cards.

name: Full Nelson
Text: When successfully played, look through your Arsenal for the card titled Maintain Hold and place that card in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Get Crowd Support
Text: Draw 1 card. Your next maneuver played this turn is +4D and your opponent's Reversal card to it is +12F.

name: Guillotine Stretch
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 1 card and you may draw 1 card.

name: Have a Nice Day!
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple or Submission maneuver. End your opponent's turn. If played from your hand, opponent discards all cards in his hand.

name: Haymaker
Text: When successfully played, all Strike maneuvers are +1D for the rest of this turn.

name: Head Butt
Text: When successfully played, discard 1 card of your choice from your hand.

name: Headlock Takedown
Text: When successfully played, your opponent draws 1 card.

name: Hellfire and Brimstone
Text: All players discard their hands and your opponent overturns 5 cards.

name: Hmmm
Text: Look at the top 5 cards of your Arsenal. You may either arrange them in any order or shuffle your Arsenal.

name: I Am the Game
Text: Draw 2 cards or your opponent discards 2 cards. Your maneuvers are +3D for the rest of the turn.

name: Irish Whip
Text: As an action, if your next card played this turn is a Strike maneuver, it is +5D. As a reversal, reverse the card titled Irish Whip and end your opponent's turn. At the beginning of your next turn, your first card played is considered to be played after the card titled Irish Whip. If it is a Strike maneuver, it is +5D.

name: Jockeying for Position
Text: As an action, if your next card played this turn is a Grapple maneuver, it is +4D or your opponent's Reversal card to it is +8F. As a reversal, reverse the card titled Jockeying for Position and end your opponent's turn. At the beginning of your next turn, your first card played is considered to be played after the card titled Jockeying for Position. If it is a Grapple maneuver, it is +4D or your opponent's Reversal card to it is +8F.

name: Kane
Text: Once during each of your turns, before your Draw Segment, your opponent overturns 1 card.

name: Kane's Flying Clothesline
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D or greater maneuver. Reversals to this card are +6D.

name: Kane's Return!
Text: Reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Overturn 4 cards. During your next turn, your maneuvers are +2D and his Reversal cards are +15F.

name: Kane's Tombstone Piledriver
Text: This card is -6F when played after the card titled Kane's Chokeslam.

name: Kick
Text: When successfully played, overturn 1 card.

name: Knee to the Gut
Text: Reverse any Strike maneuver of 7D or less and end your opponent's turn. # is equal to the reversed maneuver's Damage, read as 0 in your Ring area.

name: Leaping Knee to the Face
Text: Can only be played after the card titled Irish Whip. Cannot be reversed. When successfully played, your opponent discards 1 card.

name: Lionsault
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D or greater maneuver.

name: Lou Thesz Press
Text: When played from your hand, reverse any maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip and end your opponent's turn. You may draw 1 card.

name: Maintain Hold
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played non-Restricted-Modification-Symbol Submission maneuver. End your turn. You and your opponent cannot play any cards that do not reverse the maintained maneuver until it is reversed. Once during each of your turns, the maintained maneuver does its damage along with any effects. If the maintained maneuver is reversed, it is no longer considered maintained.

name: Manager Interferes
Text: Reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Draw 1 card.

name: Mandible Claw
Text: -6F on this card if Mr. Socko card is in your Ring area. You may play the card titled Maintain Hold after this card as if it were a Submission maneuver.

name: Mankind
Text: You must always draw 2 cards, if possible, during your draw segment. All damage from opponent is at -1D.

name: Marking Out
Text: Choose one: Look through your Arsenal and put 1 card in your hand, shuffle it and end your turn; or go through opponent's Arsenal and put any 3 cards into his Ringside pile, then shuffle his Arsenal.

name: Mr. Socko
Text: Take 1 card from either your Arsenal or Ringside pile and place it into your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal. While Mr. Socko is in your Ring area, all your maneuvers are +1D.

name: No Chance in Hell
Text: Reverse any Action card played from your opponent's hand and end his turn.

name: Not Yet
Text: Take a card in your hand, shuffle it into your Arsenal, then draw 2 cards.

name: Offer Handshake
Text: Draw up to 3 cards and then discard 1 card.

name: Open Up a Can of Whoop-Ass
Text: Draw 1 card. Your next maneuver this turn is +6D and your opponent's Reversal card to it is +20F.

name: Partner Interference
Text: When played from your hand by an inactive partner, reverse any Strike, Grapple, or High Risk.

name: Pat & Gerry
Text: Opponent skips his next turn.

name: Pedigree
Text: As a maneuver, this card is +2D when played after a Strike maneuver. As a reversal, reverse the card titled Back Body Drop and end your opponent's turn.

name: Power of Darkness
Text: +5D to all your maneuvers and +20F to all of opponent's reversals for the rest of this turn.

name: Power Slam
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Powerbomb
Text: When successfully played, you may draw 1 card. Add +1D for every maneuver with the word 'slam'in its title in your Ring area.

name: Press Slam
Text: When successfully played, you must take the top card of your Arsenal and put it into your Ringside pile. Opponent must discard 2 cards.

name: Pump Handle Slam
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 2 cards.

name: Puppies! Puppies!
Text: Cannot be played if your opponent is a Female Superstar. Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and draw 2 cards.

name: Recovery
Text: Shuffle any 2 cards from your Ringside pile back into your Arsenal. Then draw 1 card.

name: Reverse DDT
Text: When successfully played, you may draw 1 card.

name: Rock Bottom
Text: As a maneuver, search your Ringside pile and Arsenal for the card titled The People's Elbow, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn. You must discard 1 card.

name: Roll Out of the Ring
Text: Discard # cards and put # cards from your Ringside pile into your hand. # cannot be greater than 2.

name: Rolling Takedown
Text: Reverse any Grapple maneuver of 7D or less and end your opponent's turn. # is equal to the reversed maneuver's Damage, read as 0 in your Ring area.

name: Running Elbow Smash
Text: When successfully played, you must take the top card of your Arsenal and put it into your Ringside pile.

name: Samoan Drop
Text: When successfully played, your opponent discards 1 card.

name: Shake It Off
Text: Can only be played if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Put 1 card from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile. The removed card's Damage cannot be greater than your Fortitude Rating.

name: Shane O'Mac
Text: While this card is in your Ring area, at the start of your turn, before your draw segment, opponent must take the top card from his Arsenal and place it into his Ringside pile.

name: Shoulder Block
Text: As a reversal, reverse any maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip and end your opponent's turn.

name: Sleeper
Text: When successfully played, search your Arsenal for the card titled Maintain Hold, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Smackdown Hotel
Text: Draw 1 card, look at your opponent's hand, and your next maneuver played this turn is +6D.

name: Snap Mare
Text: When successfully played, if your next card played this turn is a Strike maneuver it is +2D.

name: Spear
Text: May only reverse a maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip.

name: Spinning Heel Kick
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Spit At Opponent
Text: Can only be played when you have 2 or more cards in your hand. Discard 1 card and then your opponent discards 4 cards.

name: Stagger
Text: Play after a successfully played maneuver. If your next card played this turn is a maneuver of 7D or less your opponent can not reverse it.

name: Standing Side Headlock
Text: When successfully played, your opponent draws 1 card.

name: Step Aside
Text: Reverse any Strike maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Stone Cold Steve Austin
Text: Once during each of your turns you may draw 1 card and then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Stone Cold Stunner
Text: This card is -6F when played after a card with the word 'kick' in the title.

name: Superkick
Text: When played after a successfully played 5D or greater maneuver, this card is +5D.

name: Tag in Partner
Text: As the 'active'legal player of your team you may 'tag'in a partner. You may draw 1 card. Your partner is now the 'active'legal player and may begin his turn.

name: Take That Move, Shine It Up Real Nice, Turn That Sumbitch Sideways, and Stick It Straight Up Your Roody Poo Candy Ass!
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: The People's Elbow
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played when the card titled Rock Bottom or Spine Buster is in your Ring area. As an action, this card is -10D, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and draw 2 cards.

name: The People's Eyebrow
Text: Put up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your hand and shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: The Rock
Text: You cannot pack the card titled Iron Will. Once during each of your turns, before your Draw Segment, put 1 card from your Ringside pile on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you successfully play the card titled Just Bring It!, you may draw 1 card. When you successfully play the card titled Spine Buster, search your Ringside pile and Arsenal for the card titled The People's Elbow, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Your cards titled Sharpshooter are -2F and when you successfully play that card, you may draw 1 card.

name: Torture Rack
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Tree of Woe
Text: May not be reversed. When successfully played, opponent must discard 2 cards.

name: Trip
Text: When played from your hand by an inactive partner, reverse any maneuver.

name: Triple H
Text: Your card titled A Beating You'll Never Forget is -10F. Your opponent cannot play the card titled The Game Interferes!

name: Undertaker
Text: Once during each of your turns you may discard 2 cards and then put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Undertaker Sits Up!
Text: Reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn. If played from your hand, take the top 4 cards from your Arsenal and put them in your Ringside pile. Opponent must discard 1 card; next turn, all your maneuvers are +2D, and all opponent's reversals are +25F.

name: Undertaker's Flying Clothesline
Text: Can only be played after a 5D or greater maneuver. Reversals to this maneuver are +6D.

name: Undertaker's Tombstone Piledriver
Text: As an action, this card is -30F and -25D, discard this card and draw 1 card.

name: Vertical Suplex
Text: May only reverse the maneuver titled Vertical Suplex.

name: View of Villainy
Text: Draw 1 card. Look at opponent's hand, and then make him discard all FACE cards.

name: Walls of Jericho
Text: When successfully played, if your next card played this turn is the card titled Maintain Hold, you may ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text.

name: Whaddya Got?
Text: Look at opponent's hand

name: Y2J
Text: Draw up to 5 cards or your opponent discards 5 cards.
